title: TypeSomething hero
description: Centred hero on white lit by a blush glow top-left and an acid glow on the right: an announcement pill, a huge light two-line headline, a typing line (bold verb + rotating words with a blinking acid cursor), a paragraph, two pills, and a white strip of three points hanging over the edge into a grey band.
notes: the bottom of the block is paper-grey (muted) so the strip straddles into the next grey band; follow it with a muted section
the typing line needs JavaScript; the static HTML shows the first word
name: typesomething-hero

props.name: badge
props.description: small pill above the headline (an announcement); left out when empty

props.name: title
props.description: the headline, one string per line

props.name: verb
props.description: the bold word that starts the typing line (e.g. "Ask")

props.name: words
props.description: the words typed after it, one after another

props.name: actions
props.description: one or two pills under the paragraph

props.name: highlights
props.description: three short points in the white strip at the bottom edge
